dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 21, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Guardians Shut Down Tigers in 3-1 Victory**

The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 win over the Detroit Tigers, behind a strong outing from Joey Cantillo. The left-hander pitched 5.2 innings, striking out six and allowing zero earned runs. Dillon Dingler provided the power for Cleveland, hitting his ninth home run of the season on a fly ball to left center field. Brayan Rocchio also contributed with a strong game, helping the Guardians secure the win.

**Pirates Rout Cardinals 6-2**

The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the St. Louis Cardinals, taking a 6-2 victory. Braxton Ashcraft was impressive on the mound, throwing 7.0 innings and striking out nine. Brandon Lowe had a big game at the plate, hitting his tenth home run of the season. The Pirates' offense was led by Lowe, with several other players contributing to the win.

**Mets Edge Nationals 2-1**

The New York Mets narrowly defeated the Washington Nationals, taking a 2-1 win. David Peterson earned the victory, while Cade Cavalli was saddled with the loss. Brett Baty had a standout game at the plate, helping the Mets secure the win.

**Braves Blast Marlins 9-3**

The Atlanta Braves exploded for nine runs, defeating the Miami Marlins 9-3. Michael Harris II was the star of the game, hitting two home runs and driving in three runs. Spencer Strider was dominant on the mound, striking out nine in 6.1 innings of work.
